independentMethod: Independent2^N box inclusion-exclusion over upper-only prefix DP. For each tight subset, stars-and-bars with a second bounded-composition inclusion-exclusion counts digit choices. Embedded C++ source is hash-bound; small boxes independently enumerated using Legendre factorial valuations and full base-P cubes use a closed binomial power.

mutations.label: Initializes every coordinate tight only to its upper bound
Allows a digit-column sum equal to the prime
